No clear near-term catalyst exists to re-rate the stock higher — the next meaningful event would be Q2 earnings, where guidance may need to be maintained or cut given elevated oil prices ($92.65/bbl WTI). The score reflects a quality business at a premium price with modest headwinds, warranting a mildly positive but cautious stance.
